messages:
mia: Quick request 1: StratusCloud wants a lightweight co-marketing push: marketplace listing, short benchmark blog, 40-min webinar, and joint social. Can we map owners and routing rules?

raj: I can own the marketplace listing + approvals. Need final hero metric and the Stratus co-brand kit.

omar: Ill run the benchmark write-up. Suggest headline metrics: 8k streaming p95 latency, tokens/sec and cost delta vs our baseline. Ill include a 2-line methodology and raw run links.

sophie: Ill do webinar ops and registration page. Proposed dates: Sep 15 or Sep 22 mornings PT. Need speakers locked 10 business days prior. Promo plan: announce + reminder emails, 2 LinkedIn posts, ask Stratus to amplify.

karen: Lead routing proposal: tag leads with partner=stratus and origin=marketplace_webinar. Route to partner-ops queue for 48h qualification, then to GTM Sales. SFDC fields: Partner_Tag__c, Lead_Origin__c.

mia: Owners recap:
- Marketplace listing: raj
- Benchmark blog + slides: omar
- Webinar ops + reg page: sophie
- Lead tagging & SFDC mapping: karen
- Launch copy + social: mia

raj: Ill request the asset pack from Stratus and draft the listing. Karen, can you provide the routing JSON snippet for Eng?

karen: Sure. Minimal routing snippet to hand to Eng/SFDC admin (paste into ticket):
```json
{ "partner": "stratus", "origin": "marketplace_webinar", "route": "partner-ops", "qual_hours": "48" }
```
Map Partner_Tag__c <- partner; Lead_Origin__c <- origin; AssignmentRule -> partner-ops. Include hidden partner field on the reg form.

omar: Running bench tests today; will flag any caveats (warmup, seq length noise). Will upload preliminary charts by Thu EOD.

sophie: Locking Sep 15 tentatively. Ill build the registration page template and GA/UTM tracking. Retarget window = 30d. Budget ask for paid social: $1k.

partners-bot: Reminder scheduled: request co-brand assets from StratusCloud by 2026-09-01 10:00 PT.

mia: Please update the shared tracker and add ETAs. If legal or assets block, we escalate to Partnerships. Thanks team! :rocket:
